# Release Notes

## 0.40.5 - 2026-10-19 (deployed)

Production release **0.40.5** was deployed on **2026-10-19** from protected main SHA `56f3debd95158e5ef650626148deefdd2ac98f04` (runtime PR #53). Validation run `39265010531`, approved production run `39266074822`, deployment artifact `12192568505`; deployment readback timestamp `2026-10-19T14:12:48.611893+00:00`. All eight services are healthy and live changed-module SHA256 values match exact Git blobs.

Current entitlement is independent of the card token: paid access and previously activated trials stay available without a renewal card. Promo activation requires persisted activation evidence; unactivated promo/system trials remain card-gated. Card binding remains required for future automatic charges, and recovery invoices are rejected while personal full access is already active. Family, expiry and authorization rules remain intact.

Post-deploy read-only checks: 23/23 valid activated entitlements have full access; two unactivated trials remain gated. Bot and PWA access resolvers agree for the incident customer, and the existing expiry and disabled auto-renew remain unchanged. No pending renewal or extra successful in-entitlement charges were found. A production recovery-guard probe omitted row locks only to permit a DB-read-only transaction, forbade PSP invocation and verified unchanged payment row count. Local transactional tests cover the normal locking path. No production payment/mandate mutation was used for deployment acceptance.

Validation: isolated Django 181 passed; full bot 585 tests OK (18 skipped); independent focused bot suite 13 passed; local PWA browser acceptance exit 0. Production HTTP smoke: root and PWA 200; unauthenticated profile 401; unsupported webhook method 405; internal routes are not exposed. This does not claim a new authenticated browser session or a real production charge.

Release documentation follow-up is documentation-only; the shipped runtime remains `56f3debd95158e5ef650626148deefdd2ac98f04`. Previous release history is unchanged.
